title: ext.openhands of AER records written by the openhands.events mapper (C.10; D.17.3; closed member list)
description: Verbatim OpenHands fields without a core slot, and the mapper's recorded joins. Values copied from the source are untrusted, open JSON; the member names are closed. A string over 1 MiB is replaced by {not_inlined: {sha256, bytes, media?}}. Not a published corpus schema in v0.1 (AD-10 row 13).

path_facets.description: execution: the path facets (D.17.1), the logical identity of the run

events.description: execution: the number of events in the file

id_gaps.description: execution: event ids absent between the first and the last (openhands.filtered_events@1)

first_event_timestamp.description: execution: the first event's timestamp verbatim (naive local, never converted)

last_event_timestamp.description: execution: the last event's timestamp verbatim

served_models.description: execution: the distinct model_response.model values in order of first use

state.description: execution: closed fields matched in the OpenAgentSafety state repr (openhands.state_repr_fields@1)

task_join.description: execution: the OpenAgentSafety task directory and the files found (openhands.oas_task_dir_join@1)

request_join.description: execution: the RedCode request join: source, tier, internal_id (openhands.redcode_prompt_join@1)

timestamp.description: event records: the event's timestamp verbatim (openhands.event_time_naive_local@1)

created.description: model_call: model_response.created verbatim (provider epoch; never a t value)

usage_raw.description: model_call: the provider usage object verbatim

response_content.description: assistant messages: the response had no text content

text_not_inlined.description: messages: a text over 1 MiB, by digest and size (openhands.content_not_inlined@1)

content.description: fixtures: content over 1 MiB, by digest and size

source.description: recall activities: the event's source verbatim

cause.description: notice activities: the cause event id

action.description: tool_execution: the OpenHands action type verbatim

action_timestamp.description: tool_execution: the action event's timestamp verbatim

npc.description: tool_execution of a chat call: the npc actor id the call names

observation.description: tool messages: the OpenHands observation type verbatim

success.description: tool messages: the observation's success flag verbatim

extras.description: tool messages: the observation's extras verbatim (set-of-marks images and strings over 1 MiB by digest)

seen_in.description: task-prompt fixture: the pointer of the first observation holding the task text (openhands.task_text_seen@1)

judge.description: RedCode judgement: index and last_response_full verbatim

redacted.description: tool messages: the pointers a profile redaction rule rewrote and the rule (<profile id>@<version>#<rule id>; openhands.value_redacted@1, D-606); never the original
